root_rule: Remind every active team every 15 minutes until that team's completion report and evidence are verified. A team may wait only when its own assigned work is complete and the next blocker owner is explicit.

channel_map.stop_condition: PAY_IAI_ONE_GATE_VERDICT_2026-04-23.md or PAY_IAI_ONE_PROD_GATE_STATUS_2026-04-23.md exists and explicitly states the current gate verdict.
channel_map.reminder_command: Team 1: gate note verified for 2026-04-23. Current verdict is LOCK_RETAINED_WITH_REASON. Continue watching downstream blockers, but do not re-remind this row unless a new Team 1 gate note is required.

channel_map.stop_condition: Production checkout probe no longer returns 401 API_KEY_REQUIRED and shared runtime probe exposes shared_read_model plus shared_upstream_runtime.
channel_map.reminder_command: Team 2: fix production key/header binding and deploy the shared runtime health contract. Then rerun Team 2 prod probe, shared runtime probe, pay prod gate, and pnpm test:pay. Do not rerun blindly if key/header and health contract are still unchanged.

channel_map.stop_condition: A real or true sandbox payment event calls POST /internal/payment-email/send and persists provider_ref plus mail messageId in the canonical evidence row.
channel_map.reminder_command: Team B Pay: wire the real checkout/webhook payment event to POST /internal/payment-email/send using x-pay-email-adapter-key. Persist provider_ref, order/session id, template id, mail messageId, and event status. Do not claim payment email live until D1/canonical evidence and inbox proof exist.

channel_map.team_name: Team D Payments Activation and Treasury Ops
channel_map.stop_condition: tranhatam.com has confirmed mailbox bindings, inbound routing truth, runtime binding evidence, provider ref, mail messageId, D1/canonical row, and inbox proof.
channel_map.reminder_command: Team D: complete SITE-INTAKE-100 tranhatam.com first. Bind pay@, billing@, support@, and noreply@tranhatam.com. Confirm inbound routing, mailbox ownership, MAIL_API values, provider action, provider_ref, mail messageId, D1/canonical row, and inbox proof. Keep every row below READY_FOR_LIVE while pay gate is locked.

channel_map.stop_condition: System sender proof exists for required payment sender identities with messageId, DB/log evidence, Gmail proof, Outlook proof, and internal inbox proof.
channel_map.reminder_command: Team Email SMTP: complete sender binding, workspace binding, MAIL_API_KEY handoff path, inbound route truth, /v1/send accepted proof, messageId proof, DB/log evidence, Gmail proof, Outlook proof, and internal inbox proof. BCC remains OFF. Founder/personal mailboxes do not count as proof senders.

channel_map.stop_condition: Team 1 flips pay gate and Team 5 reruns synchronized-live readiness successfully.
channel_map.reminder_command: Team 5: stay rerun-ready. Do not claim synchronized live while LOCK_RETAINED_WITH_REASON is active. After Team 1 flips pay gate, rerun live-sync readiness and final packet immediately.

channel_map.team_name: Team C Language and Bilingual QA
channel_map.stop_condition: Universal bilingual audit returns live-ready with no hard-coded public text, metadata drift, or language mixing for the remaining surfaces.
channel_map.reminder_command: Team C Language: close the Universal Bilingual Language Rebuild blockers. Move remaining pay, dash, and noos-web public copy into content sources or registries. Do not approve public live for a surface with hard-coded bilingual copy or missing SEO registry truth.

channel_map.stop_condition: Team 1 emits the final developer.iai.one reopen verdict or requests a specific delta and Team A completes it.
channel_map.reminder_command: Team A: keep developer.iai.one evidence ready. Do not reopen code scope without a Team 1 review note. If Team 1 asks for a delta, submit only that delta and evidence.

channel_map.stop_condition: cdn.iai.one has deploy/rule/cache/rollback proof and flows.iai.one has production route/runtime proof.
channel_map.reminder_command: Team B CDN/Flows: submit domain-specific evidence. CDN needs deploy log, rule snapshot, cache/header proof, and rollback note. Flows needs production route/runtime proof and refreshed packet. Do not use review-ready docs as release proof.

channel_map.stop_condition: CIOS evidence closure is committed, strict smoke proof is attached, and Team 1 accepts the review closure.
channel_map.reminder_command: Team C CIOS: if technical closure is complete, commit and attach the updated evidence packet, screenshots, test output, and strict deployed smoke proof. Until Team 1 accepts it, canonical state remains review pending.

thread_heartbeat.dispatch_mode: repo-side checker + current-thread heartbeat; external Slack/Teams transport still requires connector/runner attachment.
